blocks.text: The module explains that stream-ticket issuance replaces full access tokens in WebSocket and SSE URLs.
blocks.title: Transport credential purpose

blocks.text: The request allows only ws or sse and requires a bounded session id. The response exposes the issued ticket and configured TTL.
blocks.title: Request and response models

blocks.text: SSE requests verify chat read access before issuance. The ticket store exception becomes 503, while successful responses set no-store and return expiry.
blocks.title: Ticket issuance

gotchas: WebSocket tickets do not perform an ownership check here
Ticket is a credential and must not be cached
how_it_works: Validates ticket kind and session length
Checks chat read access for SSE tickets
Issues a ticket through the ticket store
purpose: The browser exchanges a normal bearer credential for a transport ticket and never exposes the full access token in the WebSocket or SSE URL. SSE tickets additionally require chat read access.
summary: Mints short-lived single-use tickets for WebSocket and SSE transport authentication.

raises: HTTPException 503 if ticket storage is unavailable
symbols.summary: Issues a cache-free, bounded ticket for one WebSocket or SSE session.

unknowns: Ticket redemption details are in api/stream_tickets.py.
